authorization.scope: Restore/use this existing staging project; at most five synthetic identities and one benign private PDF; no paid upgrade/new charge, external communications or production fallback

cost.basis: Observed Free organization and one active project; resuming staging uses second active Free project. No paid action permitted.

sqlReadBeforeResume.query: SELECT timestamp, database, executor and server_version only

retainedState.limitation: SQL/table/Auth/Storage row-level metadata cannot be inspected while paused. Dashboard retention notice and control-plane identity are verified; inspect metadata/counts immediately after resume, before synthetic data or schema writes. No existing customer data exported.

postconditions: Read actual DB version and retained schema/counts, bucket exposure, migration history and active schedulers
Stop before test writes if incompatible retained state, active external automation or cost change is found

recovery.unexpectedRestoreResult: Inspect actual remote status before any retry; stop on refusal or paid-plan requirement
recovery.testData: Retain run-owned private rows/objects/audits; no automatic cleanup. Test write plan must be pinned before fixture creation.
